title: Lazy Pipelines by Hand
prompt: Implement `sumEvenSquares` with `views::iota | filter | transform` and `initials` with `filter | transform` — no loops over intermediate containers.

tests.name: sumEvenSquares matches the math
tests.hint: namespace rv = std::views; for (int v : rv::iota(1, limit) | rv::filter([](int x){ return x % 2 == 0; }) | rv::transform([](int x){ return x * x; })) total += v;

tests.name: initials filters and maps
tests.code:
std::vector<std::string> words{"alpha", "be", "gamma", "hi", "fog", "delta"};
CHECK_EQ(initials(words, 3), std::string("AGD"));  // "fog" is exactly 3 chars: excluded (strictly greater)
tests.hint: words | rv::filter([n](const std::string& w){ return w.size() > n; }) | rv::transform([](const std::string& w){ return (char)std::toupper((unsigned char)w[0]); }) — accumulate into a string.
